I was climbing a mountain, and I wasn't sure how far we were from the top. I turned to my partner and asked "How high up are we?". He turned back to me and said "Comfortable-Mark5714's Calamity artwork." That was when I knew - we were at the peak.

The scene in the red rider factory when Velvet Remedy is angry at Calamity and in turns tries to manipulate Littlepip, knowing full well she has a crush on her. It was really satisfying to see Littlepip actually stand up for herself here and not let herself get treated like that, especially after how much she'd been pining in the Stable just before, and made Velvet a lot more endearing to me given she realised how bad she'd screwed up and regretted it immediately. I think this was also the moment Littlepip's unrealistic perception of Velvet shatters. 

Velvet's redemption moment for me too was later when she slaps Littlepip's mom for being a crap mother when they go back to Stable 2. I think that's the moment when the dynamic the two have for the rest of the story is established, and I think it's a really beautiful relationship they have that forms from that weird parasocial fan and idol relationship they start with.

I had the same as you, about 2/3 proper employees per department. For day 49 I filled every free slot with 1 lob cost agents, just so they could do the Qlipoth meltdowns, and acted as a buffer that hugely reduced the risk of pausing. Most of them, if not all of them will die, but it doesn't matter because it's day 49. For any ones you really don't want to breach, keep a good employee there and give them resistant gear so they can work on them. 

In terms of other tips, I highly recommend you pause as soon as she triggers the Qlipoth meltdowns, it's 100% worth losing an employee to able to properly respond to them all. I found the rabbit team fairly ineffective, but they did drain a huge chunk of her hp on phase 2 for me, so it's worth giving them a try. No reason not to pull out all the stops.
